_doc: Per letter id: one array per message (same order as letter.messages) with every eojeol of the Korean line in order (an eojeol is cut where punctuation or digits interrupt it). A token is a string (surface = lexicon_ko key), [surface, key] or [surface, key, fn]: key = lexicon id||lemma; fn = the particles and endings after the stem, "form/TAG" joined with "+" (편지를 -> ["편지를","편지","를/JKO"], 그렸어 -> ["그렸어","그리다","었/EP+어/EF"]); "tags" explains each TAG in ko and en. Digits and punctuation are not tokens.
